roles.title: Roles
roles.writeDesc: This changes a role file on disk. A copy of the current file is kept in the app's data folder first.
roles.notSaved: Not saved: the file write was not confirmed.
roles.saved: {count, plural, one {Role saved} other {# roles saved}}
roles.presetAppliedDesc: The roles and the Auto run are set up to work at their best.
roles.presetFailed: Could not apply the optimal settings
roles.intro: A role fixes the model, effort, permission mode and tools of a run. The choices come from the provider.
roles.presetTip: Sets the 7 standard roles (researcher, docs-writer, developer, reviewer, architect, manager, worker) and the Auto run to the best Claude Code-like setup: the right model, the full tool set (read-only roles can run read-only commands too) and a generous turn limit. Your descriptions and prompts are kept; a backup is made of every file it replaces.
roles.presetArmed: Click again: the 7 standard roles are overwritten
roles.emptyDesc: Create one, or use the optimal settings.
roles.driftTip: A repo keeps a different copy of this role. Open the details to compare.
roles.partialTip: The provider may ignore this level
roles.placeholderPrompt: Instructions every run of this role starts with
roles.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}

run.heavyTip: Heavy Node heap: run only one heavy server at a time
run.envTip: Environment variable names (values are never shown)
run.noServerDesc: Start a script on the left. Its output shows here, with colours; secrets are masked before they get here.

run.banner.readOnly: Read-only mode: starting a process is refused.
run.banner.heavy: {runner} is a heavy server ({rss} now). Run only one heavy server at a time.
run.pending.confirmDesc: This script asks first because of what it does. Nothing here runs without your click, and agents are never allowed to start it.
run.noRepoDesc: Add a repository to see its scripts.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.signedOut: Happy session expired. Paste a new token
integrations.p.timer.text: Start, pause and stop your Happy timer from the status bar and see today's entries.
integrations.p.chat.name: Team chat
integrations.p.meet.text: See live and upcoming meetings and join them in your browser.
integrations.p.chat.text: Read and send team messages in the Chat tab. Every message you send costs store credits.
integrations.p.notifications.name: Notifications
integrations.p.notifications.text: An unread badge in the status bar and an inbox of Happy notifications. Checked about once a minute while this window is focused.
integrations.p.tasks.name: My tasks
integrations.p.tasks.text: The tasks assigned to you, by status, with shortcuts to start the timer, copy a branch name and start an agent. Refreshed every 5 minutes while focused.
integrations.accountDesc: One connection is shared by every Happy integration. The token stays in the macOS Keychain; this window never gets it back.
integrations.baseUrlHost: The token will be sent to {host}.
integrations.tokenSaved: A token is saved. Paste a new one to replace it; a saved token cannot be shown again.
integrations.tokenPaste: Paste the Happy login token. It is checked before it is saved.
integrations.masterDesc: The master switch. Off stops everything without changing the switches below.
integrations.allow.timer: Allow starting and stopping the timer
integrations.waiting: Waiting for a token: save one above and this starts at once.
integrations.line.expired: The Happy session expired or was revoked. Paste a new token.
integrations.line.noToken: No token saved. Switched-on integrations wait for one.
roles.copies.title: Copies of this role
roles.win.primaryRepo: the copy of the run's repository
roles.pinMissing: The pinned copy no longer exists, so the default rule is used.
roles.hideTip: IntelyIDE stops using this role. The files are not touched.
roles.showHidden: {count, plural, one {Show # hidden role} other {Show # hidden roles}}
roles.deleteBuiltinTip: Built-in roles have no file. Hide them instead.
roles.deleteDesc: {count, plural, one {This deletes the file below.} other {This deletes the # files below.}} A backup of each file is saved first in {dir}.
roles.deleteRepoNote: A file inside the repository {repo}: the deletion shows up in git as a change that you commit yourself.
roles.deleteSyncNote: A sync script (for example _claude-team) may copy it back. Hide the role if you only want to stop using it.
roles.deleted: {count, plural, one {Deleted # file. The backup is kept.} other {Deleted # files. The backups are kept.}}
roles.delete.globalAffectsClaude: A global file also affects your own Claude Code sessions.
roles.delete.symlinkConfirm: The agents folder is a link to {target}. Type the role name again to delete there.
roles.delete.symlinkConfirmAria: Role name again, for the linked folder
roles.delete.err.confirmDelete: The name you typed does not match. Nothing was deleted.
roles.delete.err.builtinNoFile: A built-in role has no file, so there is nothing to delete. Hide it instead.
roles.delete.err.outsideAgentsDir: This file is not inside an agents folder, so it is not deleted.
roles.delete.err.noBackupDir: There is no safe place for the backup, so nothing was deleted.
roles.delete.err.readOnly: This IntelyIDE runs read-only, so nothing can be deleted.
roles.delete.err.testJail: Test mode: only files of the test fixture can be deleted.
roles.delete.err.unknownRole: This role file no longer exists. Reload the list.
roles.delete.err.overlayCorrupt: The roles settings file is damaged. Repair it first.
roles.delete.err.io: The backup or the delete failed. Nothing was deleted.
roles.perm.readOnly.means: Can read and search files. Cannot edit files or run commands.
roles.perm.edit.means: Can edit files in the repository. Commands and anything outside the repository ask first. Commit and push are never allowed.
roles.perm.ask.means: Asks before every edit and every command. Commit and push are never allowed.
roles.perm.auto.means: Judged like Ask: nothing runs without a check. Commit and push are never allowed.
roles.permission.runsCommands: Runs commands (each asks first), cannot edit files.
roles.permission.ceiling: Limited to Ask because this file comes from a repository.
roles.permission.ceilingNote: A role file inside a repository can never allow more than Ask, and never more than the built-in or global role of the same name. Set the permission here yourself to override.
roles.permission.mismatchBar: {count, plural, one {# role has a permission pinned by an older version that differs from what its file says.} other {# roles have a permission pinned by an older version that differs from what their files say.}}
roles.permissionSource.overlayCorrupt: Safe mode: the roles settings file is damaged, so every role is read-only.
roles.permWhy.toolsReadOnly: Because its tools are only {tools} (no Edit, Write or Bash).
roles.permWhy.toolsWrite: Because its file lists tools that change things ({tools}).
roles.permWhy.allTools: Because its file lists no tools, so it may use all of them.
roles.permWhy.noFrontmatter: Because its file has no complete --- header, so nothing in it can grant more.
roles.permWhy.none: Because every tool is switched off in its file.
roles.derivedNotice: Roles now take their permission from their own file. {count, plural, one {# role can now edit files} other {# roles can now edit files}}: {names}. Set the permission here to override.
roles.derivedNoticeAria: Roles take their permission from their file
roles.err.reservedName: {name} is reserved and cannot be used as a role name.
roles.excluded.otherProvider: runs only as a single role on another provider
roles.excluded.noDescription: no description, so the lead cannot choose it
roles.excluded.repoScope: not allowed on every repository of this run
roles.exclude.untrusted: from a repository and not trusted yet
roles.overlay.corrupt: The roles settings file is damaged. Every role is read-only until it is repaired, and nothing can be saved or hidden. A copy was kept next to it (.bak). Reset or repair the file in the IntelyIDE data folder, then reopen this page.
roles.overlay.corruptAria: The roles settings file is damaged
roles.agentsDir.symlink: The agents folder of {repo} is a link, so the roles in it are skipped.
roles.trust.untrustedTip: This role file comes from a repository and nobody approved it yet. It is never handed work and never runs with more than Ask.
roles.warn.reserved: This name is reserved, so the role is never used.
roles.warn.caseClash: Another file differs from this one only by letter case.
roles.warn.duplicateName: Two files in this folder use the same name; the first one is used.
roles.warn.toolsUnparsable: The tools line could not be read, so the role is read-only.
roles.warn.permissionModeIgnored: The permissionMode of the file is ignored: IntelyIDE never offers bypass modes.
roles.warn.mcpToolsIgnoredForDelegates: MCP tools are not given to a role that works for a lead.
roles.warn.memoryIgnored: The memory setting is shown but never passed to the role.
roles.toolsAll: No tools line in the file: the role may use all tools. Pick tools to limit it.
roles.auto.title: Auto run
roles.auto.desc: New runs start with a lead agent that hands work to your roles.
roles.auto.budgetHint: Stops the run when this much is spent. Empty means no money cap; the turn limits still apply.
settings.agents.killSwitch.title: Switches
settings.agents.killSwitch.delegation: Let the lead hand work to roles
settings.agents.killSwitch.autoOff: Auto is off: New run asks for a role, like before.
settings.agents.killSwitch.delegationOff: Delegation is off: Auto runs as one agent without roles.
roles.agentsDir.symlinkAria: A repository agents folder was skipped
roles.overlay.resetDesc: Hidden roles, pinned copies and trusted repository roles are forgotten. The role files are not touched, and the damaged file stays next to it as .bak.
roles.warn.effortXhigh: xhigh effort uses many tokens. Use it on purpose.
roles.warn.effortMax: max effort is disabled: it costs far more for little gain. Use xhigh if you must.
roles.warn.effortNotSent: This model has no effort control, so the effort is not sent.
